trello.name: Sign venue contract and confirm AV recording in all rooms
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Get the convention center contract (18,000 for main hall plus two breakout rooms, catering separate) through legal review and signed by end of next week. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and both breakouts), since last year recording was main-hall only and breakout talks were lost. Acceptance criteria: signed contract and written confirmation of recording coverage for all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup within two weeks
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either falls through, fill slots from the backup list of five names. Worst case, fill the third open slot from the backup list. Commitment: have the full lineup of nine speakers locked in two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei this week
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is needed for the website and the printed program. Acceptance criteria: keynote abstract received from Dr. Osei.

trello.name: Draft and send three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Draft all three email campaign waves this month. Wave one: agenda announcement sent the day Bo locks the lineup. Wave two: early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change. Wave three: final-week push. First wave goes out the day the agenda is live. Goal is to drive registration from current 340 toward target of 600.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots same day lineup locks
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Once the speaker lineup locks, hand the speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update on the same day. Do not sit on them. The website needs speaker pages before wave one of the email campaign goes out.

trello.name: Review swag design proofs and place swag order this week
trello.desc: Owner: Camille (review/approve) then Diego (place order). Camille will review the swag design proofs in the shared drive today. Once Camille approves, Diego places the order this week. Order contents: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, total about 9,200 including rush buffer. Lead time was six weeks last year, so ordering this week is critical. Acceptance criteria: proofs approved by Camille today and order placed by Diego this week.
